description: Invalid MT103 containing an invalid BIC code in field 57A
test_coverage: Field 57A (Account With Institution) contains invalid BIC
validation_rules_expected_to_fail: BIC must conform to ISO 9362 format (4!a2!a2!c[3!c])

invalid_field.name: Account With Institution
reasons_for_invalidity: Institution code 'INVA' contains digits (should be 4 alpha characters only)
Overall format does not match BIC pattern
Country code 'LI' may be valid but institution code is malformed
BIC must be either 8 or 11 characters (INVALID123XX is 12 characters)

correct_bic_format.description: Institution (4 alpha) + Country (2 alpha) + Location (2 alphanum) + Branch (3 alphanum, optional)

error_expected: Invalid BIC code 'INVALID123XX' in field :57A: - BIC must conform to ISO 9362 format
notes: This test validates BIC format checking. The BIC 'INVALID123XX' violates multiple rules: it's 12 characters (invalid length), contains 'INVALID1' as institution code (contains digits, should be 4 alpha), and overall doesn't match the ISO 9362 pattern. Real-world scenarios include typos in manual entry, corrupted data transmission, or incorrect bank code lookup. The validator should catch this as a format error and reject the message.
